title: ArcPearls
description: ARC Pearls improves Ender Pearl reliability by supporting stable stasis chambers, multiple active pearls, and safer persistence across relogs, chunk unloads, and server restarts.
body:
ARC Pearl is a lightweight server-side NeoForge mod designed to improve Ender Pearl stasis chamber reliability on multiplayer servers. The mod keeps stasis pearls active and stable after player disconnects, server restarts, lag spikes, and chunk-loading issues.

It also detects and removes broken, duplicated, invalid, or desynced pearl entities to help prevent failed teleports, duplicate UUID errors, stuck pearls, and console spam while keeping vanilla pearl mechanics unchanged. Optimized for SMPs, modpacks, and long-term survival worlds.

*Optional - We recommend that you turn Gamerule: enderPearlsVanishOnDeath to False
